title: Colorimetric ADP Assay Protocol
author: Kiichi Hirota
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zk4f4yw

steps.title: Plate cells in 12-well format
steps.instruction: Seed cells into a 12‑well plate and allow them to adhere as required for the assay.

steps.title: Wash cells with cold PBS
steps.instruction: Remove culture media and wash the cells twice with cold phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Lyse cells in ADP assay buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of ADP Assay Buffer to each well to lyse the cells.

steps.title: Incubate lysate on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysate for 10 min on ice.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 18,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and keep on ice
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new microcentrifuge tube and keep it on ice.

steps.title: Dilute lysate three‑fold
steps.instruction: Dilute the collected lysate 3‑fold with ADP Assay Buffer.

steps.title: Prepare 10 mM ADP stock
steps.instruction: Reconstitute 1 µmol of ADP in 100 µl water to generate a 10 mM ADP stock solution.

steps.title: Make 1 mM ADP standard
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µl of the 10 mM stock with 90 µl ADP Assay Buffer to obtain a 1 mM ADP standard solution.

steps.title: Generate ADP standard curve
steps.instruction: Prepare ADP standard dilutions of 0, 0.04, 0.08, 0.12, 0.16, and 0.2 mM in ADP Assay Buffer; use 100 µl of each dilution to provide duplicate wells (2 × 50 µl).

steps.title: Prepare reaction mix
steps.instruction: Prepare Reaction Mix sufficient for all reactions (50 µl per reaction, including standards and samples).

steps.title: Add standards and samples to plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 50 µl of each ADP standard or diluted lysate sample into wells of a clear 96‑well plate (duplicate wells).

steps.title: Add reaction mix to wells
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl of Reaction Mix to each well containing standards or samples.

steps.title: Incubate plate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Read absorbance at 750 nm
steps.instruction: Measure absorbance at 750 nm using an iMark™ Microplate Absorbance Reader.

steps.title: Record replicates
steps.instruction: Ensure each sample and standard is measured in at least two replicate wells.
